cinematic_dialogue:2:1013616001:.text:
Dura above, as the stars fade and the sunrise arrives,
please bless our journey to be smooth.
Please protect my comrades fighting by my side.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1013616001:.source_cn:
艾雅在上，当星月落尽朝阳升起，
请保佑我们踏上坦途。
请保佑与我并肩作战的同伴。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1013616002:.text:
For the sin of not recovering the Faith Stone after all these years,
I swear to make amends, no matter the cost—
cinematic_dialogue:2:1013616002:.source_cn:
时隔多年，那未能寻回圣石之罪，
我将立誓偿还，不惜代价——

say:5:1013617001:2.text: What price are you willing to pay?

say:6:1013617002:2.text: ...Am I dreaming? Atalanta, why are you here?
say:6:1013617002:2.source_cn: 我在做梦吗？阿塔兰忒，你为什么在这里？

say:7:1013617003:0.text: This isn't a dream. I'm here... in the flesh.
say:7:1013617003:0.source_cn: 你才不会梦到我呢。我就在这里……实实在在的。

say:8:1013617004:0.text: How many times must I say it? The past was my sin, not yours. But even if I were given another chance, I would make the same choice.
say:8:1013617004:0.source_cn: 还要我说多少次？当年的事，是我的罪，不是你的。但即使再...

say:9:1013617005:0.text: Are you still refusing to tell me the truth from back then?
say:9:1013617005:0.source_cn: 你还是不打算告诉我当年的真相吗？

say:10:1013617006:0.text: You know I don't want to talk about it. Why do you keep asking?
say:10:1013617006:0.source_cn: 明知道我不想说，你为何要问？我应该说过你，别这么不解风情。

say:11:1013617007:0.source_cn: 这不是开玩笑的时候，阿塔兰忒。

say:12:1013617008:0.text: Ever since I became a knight, I pledged to protect Dura. Until this day, I've followed the strictest laws of the Temple...
say:12:1013617008:0.source_cn: 我从成为骑士的那天起，就立誓守护艾雅。时至今日，我践行...

say:13:1013617009:0.text: Yet I'm still a sinner. Because, truthfully, I'm just as despicable as the worst scoundrel in this world... I willingly betrayed the grace of the goddess.
say:13:1013617009:0.source_cn: 但我仍是罪人。因为我的的确确，与世间最卑劣的恶徒一样…...

say:14:1013617010:0.text: I let you go that time. But you know, I don't regret it either.
say:14:1013617010:0.source_cn: 我放你离开了。但你知道的，我也不后悔。

say:15:1013617011:0.text: Given another chance, I'd make the same choice.
say:15:1013617011:0.source_cn: 我想说与你一样的话，即使再给我一次机会，我也会作出相同...

say:16:1013617012:0.text: But... I must make amends. To ensure my redemption isn't in vain, Atalanta, just tell me the truth...
say:16:1013617012:0.source_cn: 但……我必须为此赎罪。为了让我的赎罪不至于毫无价值，阿...

please bless our journey to be smooth.

cinematic_dialogue:20:1013616001:.source_cn:
艾雅在上，当星月落尽朝阳升起，
请保佑我们踏上坦途。
请保佑与我并肩作战的同伴。

I swear to make amends, no matter the cost—
cinematic_dialogue:20:1013616002:.source_cn:
时隔多年，那未能寻回圣石之罪，
我将立誓偿还，不惜代价——

narration:22:10136222:0.text: As the conversation between Temesia and Atalanta reaches a stalemate, Dionel suddenly makes an appearance.
narration:22:10136222:0.source_cn: 眼看特弥希娅和阿塔兰忒之间的对话快要陷入僵局，萨基塔里...

narration:23:10136221:0.text: Temesia devoutly prays to Dura, pledging to recover the Faith Stone. At that moment, the supposedly missing Atalanta reappears.
narration:23:10136221:0.source_cn: 守夜的特弥希娅向艾雅虔诚祈祷，发誓定要寻回圣石。就在此...
